# About Me!

Hey, I'm Connor! I'm a senior computer science student at VCU, with minors in math and data science. I enjoy investigating the inner workings of machine learning models and applying data science to solve difficult problems and discover insights in data. 

Outside of school, I play bass in a band weekly and go to local tech meetups to meet other tech enthusiasts. In my downtime, I enjoy relaxing with my dog on walks.
